description: Review of the commit that made a string mark a name only where a member's name is read: `omit = pytest.skip` in the body of class `Actions` marks `omit`, and head calls it as a member, `Actions.omit("x")`. Every identifier of the callee — property names included — is read against the vocabulary and the marked names: at least a WARN that it may skip `test_adds`, never silence. The real runner skips it.
